scope: Bounded alpha product evidence: team-match photo thumbnail and one detail cost-label fixture at 405, 789 and 1183 CSS pixels. Not a full-app visual or accessibility pass.
observationTiming: DOM proof and screenshot captures are separate observations, not simultaneous snapshots. Their exact UTC values are preserved. Positions can differ; no pixel-to-DOM coordinate alignment is claimed.
environment: Authenticated cloud Chromium, alpha.teameet.co.kr. Read-only navigation and observation; no product save, upload, application, payment, or permission changes reported.

deploymentContext.browserServingSHA: Not established. Cost DOM publishedBuildMeta is empty. A pre-existing SPA may retain older bundles. The workflow timestamp is contextual and does not establish which code any screenshot served.
deploymentContext.classification: Current-session observations straddling a deployment workflow completion. Do not classify as an after-test, regression verification, or fix failure for that or any integrated batch SHA.

findings.actual: Three DOM records show a 96×96 CSS-pixel photo thumbnail with linear-gradient(rgba(17,24,39,0.58),rgba(17,24,39,0.72)); filter none and element opacity 1. The gradient darkens from 58% to 72% alpha spatially, not a before/after change. All three crops show the dark animal photo without text over the photo; tablet and desktop thumb text fields are empty. Text and status are beside the thumbnail.
findings.limits: The original image brightness was not measured. No numerical WCAG contrast failure, root cause, or match to an external attachment is established. The illustration comparison is from mobile DOM only and is not a claim about every illustration.

findings.actual: At all three widths, visible cost labels read 상대팀 부담금 25,000원 and 총비용 50,000원. Fifteen label rectangles and colors/font sizes are recorded.
findings.limits: Only one displayed fixture was inspected. Equal-looking amounts do not establish an equal-sharing contract. Allocation mode, free/invitation/differential modes, copy intent and payment correctness are unverified. No agreement, fee, or payment was changed.

privacy: Only six inspected product crops and sanitized product observations are included. No conversations, participant identities, original attachments, profile photos, rosters, credentials or account data are included.
limits: Crops do not prove full-page layout, hidden content, keyboard behavior, or all states. Other allocation modes and full-app coverage remain unobserved.

additionalBoundedObservation.limits: Four flat-color CSS samples only; no pixel contrast measurement, hover/focus/disabled checks, other widths, or full-site conformance claim. The associated league screenshot is not published.
